ctx.x: The New Orleans The New Orleans The New Orleans Okay. Grab it? Yeah. Uh, give me a name please. Bill Rennett. Age? 21. Day of birth? 1936. And uh, where were you born? New Orleans, Louisiana. Have you lived in New Orleans all your life? I have. When did you first become aware that there was such a form of music as New Orleans jazz?

First of all, in my estimation, jazz has always filled a lot of places in my life. Ever since I was school enough to understand the music. I was about 12 years old when I was school enough to hear my first jazz recording. It was very breathless.
